title: A Network owner can list and add client websites (LIVE-1119)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 ("Network can resell", "do it"): PR 3 of the Network website reseller program, ADR-1816.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. /spaces/<slug>/settings/websites (owner of a Network only; the Network home has a Client websites button) lists the Network's live client sites with address, published state and the badge removal toggle, and adds a new one. createClientSite stands the site up through the shared birth steps as a Business Space owned by the Network's owner (plan business, Business depth plus the custom domain, reseller_network_id set, parent_id null so it is not a chapter), born archived so the bill does not count it, then activated and added to the bill through syncClientSiteBilling in the same call; if the bill refuses (no live Stripe price yet) the site is removed again. OPEN: the hand-off to the member as owner, domain status and a billing summary are PR 4; Stripe: the owner said yes on 2026-10-21 and the four products (prod_VTmjQ8ZOAeHseV, prod_VTmjxei6aVCv1a, prod_VTmjotosXVmYw1, prod_VTmjx5STvqK0dC) and eight prices were created live; migration 20270346021500 maps the sixteen catalog keys to them and must be applied before client sites can be billed.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('lib/collective/client-sites-actions.ts','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/network/page.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!a.includes('syncClientSiteBilling')||!a.includes(\"status: 'archived'\"))bad.push('create does not bill before it goes live');if(!p.includes('settings/websites'))bad.push('no door from the Network home');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1119: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a client site can go live without being billed, or the Network home loses its door.
